issues.observation: Both images select 新会话 with 0 次生成 and show 还没有图片. The required completed B attempt and its enabled refine / disabled variation controls are absent. A running badge and named return link are visible.
issues.repair_suggestion: Prepare B with a completed attempt before starting A; select and expand B, then recapture both widths. This evidence cannot establish the required busy-state action behavior.

issues.observation: The first attempt header and prompt are above the timeline viewport in wide; narrow shows only its bottom edge. Thus neither capture shows 第1次→第2次→第3次 with three complete thumbnails. Narrow also cuts off the expanded third card before its advanced disclosure and action buttons.
issues.repair_suggestion: Adjust timeline/card sizing or provide complementary viewport evidence showing the complete ordered history and selected card controls. Recalculate scroll positioning after changing viewport size; do not treat offscreen content as visually verified.

issues.observation: The expanded card extends below the timeline viewport. Refine-prefill and four-attempts omit both action buttons; switch-back shows only their top borders at the bottom edge, with no readable labels. The composer itself remains visible.
issues.repair_suggestion: Keep the selected card actions visible after resize and composer growth, for example by scrolling the action row into view or using a persistent action row. Recapture at 900×700. A screenshot does not establish whether manual scrolling would recover them.

issues.observation: Header correctly says 尚未安装图片模型，请到「资源」页下载, but the bottom status instead says 图片 MLX 运行环境缺失，请安装 .venv-image 或使用包含图片运行时的应用. Required model-download status is absent there. Generate appears disabled.
issues.repair_suggestion: Capture model-missing with runtime available and show the model-download explanation in the status line; if multiple failures coexist, make the priority explicit and add separate evidence.

issues.repair_suggestion: Move seed metadata into an expanded advanced disclosure, or obtain an explicit acceptance-standard change if the library is intended to be exempt; the current written standard does not exempt it.

issues.observation: The 已取消 badge, gray X icon and two actions are clear, but no separate cancellation explanation is visible; the repeated text 会被取消的一张 is the prompt.
issues.repair_suggestion: Add a brief explanation such as 已取消本次生成，未生成图片 below the status, preserving the existing controls.

issues.criteria_ref: visual-acceptance-criteria.md § delete-confirm: 取消获得焦点
issues.observation: Cancel has an ordinary dark button border with no discernible focus indicator in these captures. Dialog wording, danger styling and running continuation sentence are readable. Actual DOM focus cannot be established from these pixels.
issues.repair_suggestion: Give the initially focused Cancel button a clearly visible focus treatment and capture it; verify keyboard focus separately.

issues.criteria_ref: batch-A-harness.md declared mock layers; § attempt-selected-actions; § library-after-delete
issues.observation: Gradient images render at approximately 96×64, including expanded/preview images. This is consistent with the declared small PNG fixture, not a broken-image defect. Library views cannot simultaneously show the image-session sidebar; verify-after-delete provides the complementary remaining-session view.
issues.repair_suggestion: Keep fixture limitations explicit and use batch B to assess real-resolution image sizing. Do not claim model-output quality or actual-resolution preview coverage from batch A.

issues.criteria_ref: attempt-selected-actions / D-72, D-74, D-86; AC-7; batch visual question 2
issues.observation: Both screenshots show an expanded lighthouse image but neither action button. The attempt header is above the visible timeline area, so its number cannot be verified. In narrow, the image bottom is also cut off at the timeline/composer boundary. Wide shows the full large image, but still no actions.
issues.repair_suggestion: Size the expanded image against the available timeline height and keep the actions visible; scroll the selected card into an appropriate position. Re-capture both widths showing the attempt identity, complete image and both complete action labels. This evidence does not establish whether the buttons exist farther down the scroll area.

issues.observation: Attempt 1 is mostly above the timeline viewport: only the bottom of its thumbnail/card is visible. Attempts 2 and 3 have real lighthouse thumbnails and readable metadata, but attempt 3’s expanded image extends below the viewport, and its detailed prompt, advanced-parameter control and both actions are not visible. The required three-card sequence and expanded-card contents are not fully demonstrated.
issues.repair_suggestion: Arrange or size the three-round state to show the required sequence and expanded controls at both widths; provide complementary scroll-position screenshots if the full state cannot fit. Do not use DOM records as a substitute for missing visual evidence.

issues.observation: Attempt 5 visibly has an 已取消 badge and a grey X icon block, with no broken image or running indicator. Its lower text is cut at the timeline boundary and both required actions are outside the captured area. The wide counterpart does show both actions.
issues.repair_suggestion: After resizing, bring the expanded cancelled card fully into view or reduce its vertical footprint; re-capture narrow with its explanatory text and both actions visible.

issues.criteria_ref: Global rules: no visible 种子 except inside expanded 高级参数; batch visual question 4
issues.observation: Library metadata visibly includes 种子 889538739 for the bamboo image and 种子 1248066557 for the cancelled attempt; wide also shows another seed on a lower row. These are plain list metadata, not an expanded advanced-parameter block. The supplied global rule explicitly applies to every screenshot and gives no library exception.
issues.repair_suggestion: Move seed metadata into expanded advanced parameters in the library as well, or obtain an explicit acceptance-standard scope revision before re-review. Under the current standard these screenshots fail.

issues.criteria_ref: library-after-delete / D-30; AC-5: 图片页会话列表里已无该会话
issues.observation: The bamboo image is visibly rendered and listed with its matching title, satisfying the preview portion. Neither library screenshot shows the image-page session list, so the required absence of the deleted session is not visually demonstrated. This is an evidence gap, not a claim that deletion failed.
issues.repair_suggestion: Add paired post-deletion image-page screenshots showing the remaining session list, alongside the library preview, and include them in the acceptance batch for inspection.

issues.criteria_ref: delete-confirm / D-90; required 取消 focus
issues.observation: The modal title, image-retention wording and red 删除 action are clear and fit both widths. However, 取消 has no distinct visible focus indicator; a strong blue outline remains visible around the background session item. Pixels alone cannot establish the actual focused DOM element.
issues.repair_suggestion: Ensure initial focus moves to 取消 and give it a visible keyboard-focus indicator; capture that state. Verify focus behavior separately rather than infer it from these screenshots.

issues.observation: Refine screenshots show a focused, prefilled prompt matching attempt 2, an 沿用第 2 次的构图 chip with ×, and collapsed composer advanced parameters. Restart screenshots show both sessions, restored lighthouse thumbnails and cancelled attempt 5. These are visual observations; ARIA values, persistence causality, naturalWidth and exact scroll metrics cannot be proved from pixels. Normal clipping at a scroll-container boundary is not by itself evidence of overlapping DOM regions.
issues.repair_suggestion: Retain these visual checks and verify semantic attributes and restart causality separately. Do not treat the known missing document scrollbar in WKWebView snapshots as a defect.

issues.observation: Both harness screenshots correctly show A as generating, B selected with a completed gradient image, a named busy message, 回到该会话, enabled refine styling and disabled generate/recompose styling. The top global strip nevertheless says 媒体：空闲 and 可开工, contradicting the session-level busy state.
issues.repair_suggestion: Make the harness supply consistent global busy status, then confirm the same consistency with real-app evidence; the screenshots alone do not show whether this discrepancy exists outside the harness.
